function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread with iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotion. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | Smart satire meets genuine scares; a fresh take on social horror. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | Daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | An inventive premise where the threat is always just behind you. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Silence is the ultimate weapon—thrilling tension without a single scream. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror that explores grief through a sinister monster. |
| 8 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | Atmospheric period horror that builds dread slowly but surely. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** | 1977 | Dario Argento | Classic Italian giallo with vivid color and haunting music. |
|10 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | Modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑life paranormal investigations. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a slow burn or a jump‑scare‑heavy experience!
